name: TeamBar collapsible with icon view
description:
# Conversation Summary

I don't have a previous conversation to summarize. This appears to be the beginning of our chat, where you've provided three Vue component files:

1. **TeamBar.vue** - A collapsible sidebar component for team navigation with user info
2. **TeamChannelsIconView.vue** - An icon-based view of team channels in collapsed mode
3. **RecentChatsQuickAccess.vue** - A component displaying recent chats with infinite scroll support

These components work together to create a responsive team/chat navigation system that toggles between expanded (detailed) and collapsed (icon-only) views.
